title: Group named fields
summary: F#: Group named fields. Print book.Pages too.
introduction: A record has named fields. A new record can copy an old one with one field changed.

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Group named fields

blocks.text: The with expression copies the record and changes only Pages in the new value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The with expression creates a new value.
